text: だって　ポケモンジムの　ほかに　いけばな　きょうしつ　やってるから
note: Ikebana is the traditional Japanese art of flower arranging, long taught as a refined accomplishment for young women. It fits this Gym's image of well-bred ladies.
claim: Ikebana is the traditional Japanese art of flower arranging and was long taught as an accomplishment for young women.

check.quote: Especially during the Meiji (1868-1912) and Taisho (1912-1926) periods, many urban young women practiced Ikebana to make themselves more desirable brides-to-be, a custom that could still be observed until quite recently.
